title: Rosa tackles the harvest (paraphrase D)
topic: A farmer named Rosa brings in the wheat harvest: the combine cuts the field, sacks of grain go onto a trailer, clouds gather, the family works until evening, Rosa closes the gate
tail_E: At the mill the sacks are emptied and the wheat is ground into fine white
target_note: Same target as formulations A to C: 'flour' is predictable only from the harvest context (wheat, grain, sacks, a mill); wheat ground at a mill gives flour, and 'fine white' narrows the completion to it. The word does not occur in the units or the tail, and neither does its German equivalent 'Mehl'. ' flour' is a single Pythia token (id 12274). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only): p(' flour') = 0.17 on the all-English rendering, rank 1 (next: ' grain' 0.04); still rank 1 (p = 0.21) on the K=8 C3 rendering. Shorter tails ending in '... grinds the new grain into fine white' were rejected because pythia-160m ranks ' grain' first there (the units of this formulation mention grain twice).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus authoring (DEV04D, farmer Rosa, paraphrase D, development family)
notes: Formulation D: fourth independent re-phrasing of the ten DEV04A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Rosa, wording different from A, B and C). Replacements include tackles the harvest in the first morning light (nimmt die Ernte in Angriff im ersten Morgenlicht), yellow grain bends in the warm breeze (gelbes Korn neigt sich in der warmen Brise), handles the combine out in the field (führt den Mähdrescher draußen auf dem Feld), the cutter slices the stalks in clean rows (das Schneidwerk zerteilt die Halme in sauberen Reihen), shovels the grain into stout sacks (schaufelt das Korn in dicke Säcke), harvest hands throw the sacks onto the trailer (Erntehelfer werfen die Säcke auf den Anhänger), aged tractor drags the trailer homeward (betagter Traktor schleift den Anhänger heimwärts - one-word adverbial adjunct), grey clouds thicken quickly over the hill country (graue Wolken verdichten sich rasch über dem Hügelland), young and old work hard until nightfall (Groß und Klein arbeiten hart bis zum Einbruch der Nacht - coordinated subject for the whole family), bars the gate after the long day (versperrt das Tor nach dem langen Tag). Units 2 and 8 use reflexive verbs (neigt sich, verdichten sich); no separable verbs. Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Development family: used for dose/threshold choice only.
